title: Does GTA 6 Have Online? GTA 6 Online Release Date: What's Confirmed
desc: Is there a GTA 6 Online? Not yet: Rockstar hasn't announced a multiplayer mode or a date. Where the '2027' talk comes from, and what happens to GTA Online. Checked Nov 24.
lede: Short answer: there is no GTA 6 Online yet, and Rockstar hasn't announced one or given a date. GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026 as a single-player game on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The '2027' you see everywhere isn't from Rockstar.
sections: Not at launch. Rockstar describes GTA 6 as a single-player experience and hasn't announced a multiplayer mode or confirmed whether one will come later (VICE, GTABase, HuffPost).
From Twitch CEO Dan Clancy, who told Bloomberg in September that multiplayer would launch "next year". That's not a Rockstar announcement, so treat it as a report, not a date (VICE, Covers).
Take-Two has said it will keep supporting the current GTA Online (the GTA 5 one) after GTA 6's release (GTABase, HuffPost). That's the old game's online mode, not a GTA 6 multiplayer.
If you see a site with an exact GTA 6 Online date, it's guessing. We'll update this page the moment Rockstar says anything: GTA 6 live updates.
note: Checked November 24, 2026. Vice Replay is a fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
